scope: Static cash-flow audit of the integrated TTMI workshop/catalogue; no browser or player save was used.
assumptions: Plain native resale floor(p * 0.3); noSell outputs valued at zero for achievable cash.
TTMI shop, workshop and custom-container gains force ordinary items, so attribute/blessed/ancient resale multipliers do not apply.
Single-use container analysis recursively opens imported boxes/exchanges at most once, with original uniform item and count sampling; repeatable bodies may be resold afterwards.

Ingredient acquisition uses TTMI prices, native shops at the cheapest siege discount, and these 893 deterministic workshop recipes; class gates and integer purchase/craft batches are relaxed downwards, so costs are conservative lower bounds.

No input is priced as free merely because it can drop. No global claim is made about other crafting NPCs, acquisition by random boxes, black-market buy orders, enchantment/affix conversions or long-term player gold/hour.
